show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/huWDbb
show.description:
Kiara Khanna, ek ziddi aur bold ladki, ek andheri raat ek bhikhari jaise dikhne wale ladke Rudra se takra jaati hai — jise wo bina soche apne ghar le aati hai... aur shadi kar leti hai! Par kisi ko kya pata tha ki yeh 'bhikhari' asal mein hai India ka sabse powerful businessman, jiska plane crash hua tha aur jise sab log mara hua samajh baithe the. Jab dushman uski biwi ko usse chheenne ki koshish karte hain, Rudra wapas aata hai — is baar apne asli roop mein!
Lekin kya Kiara sach mein usse uske paiso se alag pehchaan payar karti hai?
Aur kya Rudra apni pehchaan, company aur pyaar dono bachaa paayega?
